nodes.description: Total token supply stored in the EIP20Interface base contract; written once in the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to remaining allowance; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Human readable token name set in the constructor.
Decimals used for display, set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant MAX_UINT256 = 2**256 - 1 used as the infinite-allowance sentinel in transferFrom.
VietnamToken constructor: allocates the initial supply to msg.sender and sets name, decimals and symbol.
Public transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after a balance require check.
Public transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens on behalf of _from using the caller's allowance.
View balanceOf(address) returning balances[_owner].
Public approve(address,uint256): sets the caller's allowance for _spender (classic ERC20 approve race condition).
View allowance(address,address) returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
msg.sender: attacker controlled caller address used as the key for balance and allowance state writes.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer(): unchecked subtraction guarded only by a require.
balances[_to] += _value in transfer(): unchecked addition to an arbitrary recipient balance.
balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount in the constructor: unrestricted minting of the whole supply to the deployer.
balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom(): unchecked addition credited before the sender is debited.
balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom(): unchecked subtraction after the recipient is credited.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom(): unchecked allowance decrement inside the MAX_UINT256 guard.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value in approve(): unconditional overwrite enabling the approve race condition.
Constructor parameter _initialAmount: initial token supply credited to msg.sender.
Constructor parameter _tokenName: display name copied into state.
Constructor parameter _decimalUnits: display decimals copied into state.
Constructor parameter _tokenSymbol: token symbol copied into state.
transfer parameter _to: recipient address, used as the key for the balance credit.
transfer parameter _value: amount subtracted from the sender and added to the recipient.
transferFrom parameter _from: owner address debited and used as the allowance key.
transferFrom parameter _to: recipient address credited with the tokens.
transferFrom parameter _value: amount debited from _from and from the caller allowance.
balanceOf parameter _owner: address whose balance is read.
approve parameter _spender: address granted the allowance.
approve parameter _value: allowance amount written into storage.
allowance parameter _owner: owner key of the allowance mapping.
allowance parameter _spender: spender key of the allowance mapping.
Local variable allowance in transferFrom(): cached allowed[_from][msg.sender] used for the require and the MAX_UINT256 comparison.

edges.reason: The constructor executes the initial supply write to balances[msg.sender]; anyone who deploys the contract mints the entire supply.
transfer() body executes the unchecked subtraction of _value from balances[msg.sender].
transfer() body executes the unchecked addition of _value to balances[_to].
transferFrom() body credits balances[_to] before debiting the sender, an ordering hazard.
transferFrom() body executes the unchecked subtraction from balances[_from].
transferFrom() body conditionally decrements the caller allowance inside the MAX_UINT256 guard.
approve() unconditionally overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender], allowing the approve/spend race.
msg.sender is the implicit caller of the public transfer() entry point, so any account may invoke it.
msg.sender is the implicit caller of the public transferFrom() entry point, consuming its own allowance.
msg.sender is the implicit caller of approve() and becomes the allowance owner key.
msg.sender indexes balances in the transfer subtraction, so the caller may only debit its own balance.
msg.sender is the event emitter/source address passed to the Transfer event alongside the credited recipient.
msg.sender is the beneficiary key of the constructor balance write, giving the deployer the whole supply.
msg.sender indexes the nested allowance mapping in transferFrom, so a caller can only spend its own allowance.
msg.sender is the owner key written by approve(), restricting the write to the caller's own allowance slot.
msg.sender is used as a mapping key into balances across transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
msg.sender is used as a mapping key into allowed in transferFrom and approve.
_initialAmount flows directly into the balances[msg.sender] assignment in the constructor.
_initialAmount is written into totalSupply in the constructor.
_tokenName is copied into the name state variable.
_decimalUnits is copied into the decimals state variable.
_tokenSymbol is copied into the symbol state variable.
_value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without a SafeMath guard.
_value is added to balances[_to] without a SafeMath guard.
_to is the recipient mapping key used for the balance credit in transfer().
_value is added to balances[_to] during transferFrom before the sender is debited.
_value is subtracted from balances[_from] without a SafeMath guard.
_value is subtracted from the caller allowance, reducing it by an attacker influenced amount.
_from is the source address whose tokens are being transferred in transferFrom.
_from is the mapping key debited in transferFrom.
_from is the outer key of the allowed mapping consulted in transferFrom.
_to is the recipient mapping key credited in transferFrom.
_value is written verbatim into allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with no prior allowance reset.
_spender is the inner key of the allowance write in approve().
_owner indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf().
_owner indexes the allowed mapping read by allowance().
_spender indexes the inner allowed mapping read by allowance().
The cached local allowance gates and is decremented by the unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
The cached allowance is compared against _value before balances[_from] is debited.
MAX_UINT256 is the sentinel compared against the allowance, skipping the decrement for infinite approvals.
The subtraction writes back into the balances mapping for msg.sender.
The addition writes back into the balances mapping for _to.
The constructor assignment writes the initial supply into the balances mapping.
The constructor also assigns _initialAmount into totalSupply.
The credit in transferFrom writes into balances[_to].
The debit in transferFrom writes into balances[_from].
The conditional decrement writes into the nested allowed mapping.
approve() writes directly into allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with no increase/decrease helper.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the constructor's supply initialization and is not independently exploitable.
Cosmetic string parameter written once into name; no security-relevant flow on its own.
Cosmetic numeric parameter written once into decimals.
Cosmetic string parameter written once into symbol.
Recipient argument of transfer, merged into the unchecked credit operation it indexes.
Amount argument of transfer, dominated by the unchecked subtraction from the sender balance.
Source argument of transferFrom, merged into the unchecked debit of balances[_from].
Recipient argument of transferFrom, merged into the pre-debit credit operation.
Amount argument of transferFrom, consumed by the allowance decrement and the balance debits.
Read-only lookup key of a view function; no mutation flow to track.
Spender argument of approve, merged into the unconditional allowance overwrite.
Allowance amount argument of approve, written verbatim into storage.
Read-only owner key of a view function; no state mutation.
Read-only spender key of a view function; no state mutation.
Temporary cache of allowed[_from][msg.sender] used only to guard and decrement the allowance.
